newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-PANEL SETS KLASCO, LISCO SALE SHORT LIST.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-PANEL SETS KLASCO, LISCO SALE SHORT LIST.

text.p: The Lithuanian transport privatisation comission said on Wednesday that it has drawn up two short lists of nine candidates each to advise the government on the privatisation of the KLASCO and LISCO transport firms.

The short list of advisors for the privatisation of Lithuanian Sea Shipping company (LISCO) included American Marine Advisors, Barents group, Rogge Marine, Union Bank of Switzerland, Coopers &Librant, PRI, Eurofin, Treuhand Osteuropa Beratung and Moore Stephens, the panel said.

It added that Barents group, Treuhand Osteuropa Beratung, Price Waterhouse, Coopers &Librant, PRI, Keinbaum, Eurofin, Rogge Marine and UBS were on the short list for the Klaipeda Stevedoring company (KLASCO) privatisation.

"The financial offers will have to be submited by August 25 and the commission is expected to decide on the winner by the end of August," the chairman of the comission Alfredas Ramanauskas told Reuters.
KLASCO is a 90 percent state-owned company and its the biggest of its kind in Klaipeda port.
The state has an 80 percent stake in LISCO.
